content.title: IEX Q3 Deep Dive: Organic Growth and Platform Integration Offset Cautious Guidance
content.summary: Manufacturing company IDEX (NYSE:IEX) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 10.1% year on year to $878.7 million.
